anomalies.observed: The 0 Ω links R16 and R18 connect J2 pins 19 and 21 to the same net. The 0 Ω links R10 and R3 likewise connect J2 pins 20 and 22 to the same net. Thus both alternative GPIO mappings are joined in the design.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes variant-dependent jumper selection between these bus pins, not simultaneous connection of both alternatives. The two GPIO pins in each pair should remain separate; only the appropriate mapping should be fitted for the M5Stack variant.

evidence.quote: R9–R12 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | Select which M5Stack bus pin (pin 19/21 for ch.1, pin 20/22 for ch.2) supplies PWM1/PWM2

anomalies.impact: The paired M5Stack GPIO pins are electrically shorted through the zero-ohm links. If both pins are driven independently, this can cause output contention and prevent the intended variant-specific PWM mapping from working correctly.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows zero-ohm links joining both GPIO alternatives in each mapping pair (pins 19/21 and 20/22). This conflicts with the specification’s variant-dependent jumper selection and can short independently driven GPIOs.
